newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks open lower, techs mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks open lower, techs mixed.

text.p: U.S. stocks opened lower on Monday, extending losses made Friday after the release of strong economic data revived market concerns about inflation and the possibility of higher rates.
The Dow Industrials index was off 14.40 at 8,179.64. The Nasdaq Composite was off 1.58 at 1,92.75, while the S&P Index was down 0.96 at 946.18.
As Wall Street opened the 30-year long bond was off 13/32 at 6.48 percent yield.
